title: Regression: dragging TermAl tabs between Chrome browser tabs or windows stopped working (Greg, P0)
outcome:
Reported by Greg at about 16:55Z on 2026-11-24, relayed by Engram::Asistant (TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2650). Verbatim: „drag and drop tab'ow pomiedzy tabami chroma przestalo dzialac!!" ("drag and drop of tabs between Chrome tabs stopped working!!"). Asistant adds: it is about dragging TermAl tabs BETWEEN Chrome browser tabs or windows. Do not assume it is only reordering within one browser tab.

Facts so far (Termal::Fable2, read-only):
- The running host is fbc6fd0c, restarted at about 03:43Z. ui/dist/index.html was rebuilt at about 06:38Z on 2026-11-24, after the restart.
- No commit since 2026-11-15 touches UI drag code: `git log -G 'dataTransfer|dragstart|drag' -- ui/src` is empty. ui/src/tab-drag.ts and session-drag.ts are unchanged since 2026-11-10.
- So the cause is not an obvious drag-code change. Candidates to check: the ui/dist build itself (what was served before the rebuild versus now); server-side state that cross-window drag relies on, such as the workspace-layout or session APIs and any cross-tab channel; a Chrome update; and the w-314a session-list filter, if a dragged tab carries a session the new filter hides or rejects.

Wanted:
- Reproduce it.
- Identify the cause with evidence: the exact behaviour, and the console or network errors.
- Fix it, with a behaviour test where feasible.
- Report the cause and an ETA to the coordinator.
acceptance: Regression: dragging TermAl tabs between Chrome browser tabs or windows stopped working (Greg, P0) is done
disposal_reason: Withdrawn by Greg ~16:56Z 2026-11-24 (Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #2651): „false alarm, mialem wersje dev i release, dziala wszystko! uff". No regression; dev and release instances were mixed. No code change.
